events.title: Kudremukh Peak: Rainforest & Clouds Trek
events.tagline: Hike through emerald shola grasslands and mystical rolling ridges.
events.description:
Ascend Karnataka's third-highest peak shaped like a horse's face ('Kudremukh'). Walk along protected national park ridges, cross pristine mountain streams, and immerse yourself in lush green rainforest valleys. 

This is a certified eco-conscious, zero-litter group expedition led by accredited mountain wilderness first-responders. We travel together in a private tempo traveller from Bengaluru, camp in eco-homestays, and summit together at dawn.
events.meeting_point: Shantala Silk House, Majestic, Bengaluru (Pickups at Domlur & Yeshwantpur)

itinerary.title: Overnight Journey from Bengaluru
itinerary.description: Meet your trek leads and fellow adventurers at the pickup points. Icebreakers, music, and an overnight scenic drive to Chikmagalur.

itinerary.title: Homestay Arrival & The Ascent
itinerary.description: Fresh up at the traditional coffee plantation homestay, heavy Malnad breakfast, collect packed trail lunches, and obtain forest department permits. Trek 22 km round trip through misty shola forests and steep grassland climbs.

itinerary.title: Campfire, Stories & Hot Dinner
itinerary.description: Relax after descending. Gather around a warm acoustic bonfire, exchange stories under starry skies, and feast on traditional dinner.

itinerary.title: Hidden Waterfall Dip & Return
itinerary.description: Morning stroll through coffee estates, visit a secluded natural waterfall for a refreshing swim, lunch at Belur, and return to Bengaluru by 9 PM.

inclusions: Round-trip AC transportation from Bengaluru
Kudremukh Forest Department permit fees & guide charges
1 night shared accommodation at rustic eco-homestay
2 Breakfasts, 1 Packed Lunch, 1 Dinner, evening tea/snacks
Certified wilderness trek leaders and first-aid support
Badges, Social Club bandana, and digital photo album
exclusions: Meals during transit (Friday dinner & Sunday dinner)
Personal medical expenses and travel insurance
Anything not specifically listed under inclusions
things_to_bring: Sturdy trekking shoes with deep lug grip (mandatory)
2-3 Litres reusable water bottle / hydration bladder
Government Photo ID (original Aadhaar/Passport for forest check-post)
Torch or headlamp with extra batteries
Quick-dry t-shirts and trekking track pants
Personal toiletries and basic personal medication
safety_instructions: Zero-tolerance policy on alcohol, narcotics, and littering on forest trails.
Strictly follow instructions from the designated trek leads at all river crossings.
Inform the team of any pre-existing medical conditions (asthma, heart, joint issues) before departure.
Stay strictly on the marked trails to avoid ecological disturbance.
events.cancellation_policy: Cancel up to 5 days prior for an 85% refund or 100% credit voucher. 50% refund between 4-2 days. No refunds within 48 hours of departure.

faqs.question: Can beginners participate in this trek?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided you have a basic baseline fitness (can jog 3 km without pausing). The total distance is 22 km, which can be challenging if completely sedentary.

faqs.question: Is single/solo traveler welcome?
faqs.answer: Over 65% of our community members sign up solo! You'll be welcomed warmly and paired with like-minded adventurers.

faqs.question: What are the homestay restroom facilities like?
faqs.answer: Clean western toilets with hot water facilities are provided at the plantation homestay base.

events.title: Pawna Lake: Stargazing & Acoustic Bonfire
events.tagline: Waterfront dome tents, acoustic jam sessions, barbecue, and open-air stargazing.
events.description:
Escape city chaos and unwind right on the serene banks of Pawna Lake, flanked by historic Sahyadri forts (Tung and Tikona). 

Arrive by afternoon, dive into kayaking and sunset volleyball, enjoy live acoustic guitar melodies around the campfire, roast marshmallows, and sleep under a blanket of unpolluted constellations in twin/triple sharing weather-proof camping tents.
events.destination: Pawna Dam Reservoir, Lonavala / Pune outskirts
events.meeting_point: Campsite Bay 4, Pawna Lake (Directions & GPS shared upon booking)
events.travel_mode: Self-Drive / Carpool organized in private WhatsApp group

itinerary.title: Check-in & Lakeside High Tea
itinerary.description: Welcome drink, snack on hot pakoras, tent allocations, and leisure sunset viewing.

itinerary.title: Kayaking & Lawn Games
itinerary.description: Take out sit-on-top kayaks with life jackets, play frisbee, badminton or board games.

itinerary.title: Live Barbecue & Acoustic Music
itinerary.description: Unlimited veg/non-veg BBQ skewers, campfire storytelling, acoustic guitar singalongs.

itinerary.title: Golden Sunrise & Buffet Breakfast
itinerary.description: Poha, eggs to order, chai/coffee, morning dip in clean designated lake section, checkout by 11 AM.

inclusions: Twin/Triple sharing dome tent with foam mattresses, clean bedsheets, and pillows
Welcome tea & snacks, unlimited BBQ snacks (1 hour), buffet dinner, breakfast
Kayaking gear & life jackets with safety instructor
Bonfire setup and acoustic guitar session
Clean washroom and shower blocks with running water
Free campsite car parking
exclusions: Travel from Mumbai/Pune to Pawna campsite (carpool coordination assisted)
Packaged mineral water and personal beverages
things_to_bring: Warm hoodie or light jacket (gets breezy at night)
safety_instructions: Life jackets are strictly mandatory before entering any watercraft or lake zone.
Swimming after 6:30 PM is strictly prohibited.
Respect camp quiet hours after 12:30 AM.
events.cancellation_policy: 100% refund up to 72 hours before check-in. 50% refund within 48 hours. No refund within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Is the campsite safe for solo female campers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We have dedicated female trek leads on site, a secured private perimeter, and 24/7 security staff.

faqs.question: Are washrooms hygienic?
faqs.answer: Yes, we maintain Western and Indian style tiled restrooms with regular sanitization.

events.title: Konkan to Gokarna: Coastal Highway Expedition
events.tagline: Cliffside sunsets, ferry crossings, secluded beaches, and beach shack conversations.
events.description:
Drive through one of India's most breathtaking coastal routes. We wind through winding coconut grooves, stop at hidden sea cliffs, cross river estuaries on rustic vehicle barges, and spend our evenings listening to the waves at Kudle and Om beach.

Travel in our private convoy or join in our communal tempo cruiser. Great music, spontaneous tea stops, and unforgettable coastal horizons.

itinerary.title: Bengaluru to Honnavar Mangrove Boating
itinerary.description: Early morning start, highway breakfast, scenic drive down the Ghats to Honnavar. Backwater boat ride through backwater islands, sunset at Eco Beach.

itinerary.title: Gokarna 5-Beach Cliff Trail
itinerary.description: Gentle panoramic hike traversing Belekan Beach, Paradise Beach, Half Moon Beach, Om Beach, and Kudle Beach. Sunset beach cafe meetup.

itinerary.title: Mirjan Fort Exploration & Return
itinerary.description: Visit historic 16th-century Mirjan Fort covered in moss, traditional coastal thali lunch, and return drive to Bengaluru.

inclusions: Entire travel across all 3 days in dedicated AC cruiser
2 nights boutique beach-side resort stay (AC double sharing)
Daily breakfast buffet and Honnavar boat safari entry
Guided Gokarna 5-beach cliff trek with certified trip leaders
All tolls, parking fees, and driver allowances
exclusions: Lunch and dinner cafes (we love exploring local eateries together)
Water sports (banana ride/jet ski at Om Beach)
things_to_bring: Sandals / water shoes + 1 pair walking sneakers
safety_instructions: Do not swim in rocky non-patrolled sections of Half Moon beach.
Wear life vest during the Sharavathi backwater boat tour.
Follow designated convoy speed and meetup stops.
events.cancellation_policy: Cancel 7+ days in advance for 90% refund. 50% refund 3-6 days in advance. No refund within 72 hours.

faqs.question: Can I bring my own car and join the convoy?
faqs.answer: Yes! Select 'Self-Drive Participant' during checkout for an adjusted fee of ₹4,299 per person including stays and guided tours.

events.title: Sunrise Coffee, Bouldering & Board Games
events.tagline: Start your Sunday outdoors with good brew, introductory rock bouldering, and relaxed conversations.
events.description:
A relaxed Sunday morning gathering designed to help you meet friendly city dwellers outside bars and screens. 

We gather at Turahalli Forest hillocks at 6:30 AM for a gentle boulder scramble and sunrise watch, followed by specialty pour-over coffee brewed right at the rocks, and an interactive tabletop board game session in the shade.
events.destination: Turahalli Forest Viewpoint, Kanakapura Road, Bengaluru

itinerary.title: Meetup & Sunrise Hike
itinerary.description: Quick icebreaker at North gate, 15-minute trail walk to the summit boulder.

itinerary.title: Introductory Bouldering & Crashpad Scramble
itinerary.description: Certified climbing instructors demonstrate basic footwork and safe spotting.

itinerary.title: Fresh Brew Bar & Tabletop Games
itinerary.description: Fresh artisanal pour-over coffee, warm croissants, Codenames, and conversation cards.

inclusions: Free community participation & climbing shoes loaner
Artisanal coffee tasting station
Board games & social icebreaker games
Safety gear & climbing crash pads
safety_instructions: Spotting required on boulders higher than 2 meters.
events.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation anytime. Please release your ticket if you cannot make it so someone on the waitlist can attend.

faqs.question: Is this event truly free?
faqs.answer: Yes! Social Club hosts monthly free community meetups to keep the outdoors welcoming and accessible to everyone.
